race.comment: GAULTIER (12) Exceedance gelding resuming from a lengthy break. Closed strongly on debut when fifth over 1000m at Caulfield Heath 15 months ago. J Mac has ridden him in both trials and gets his chance from the low draw with the lugging bit going on. UNION (5) eased sharply in betting on resumption and ran accordingly with a tiring third over 1000m at Kembla Grange. Can take control early and prove hard to get past. HARRY'S HUSSEY (7) is a well-bred Harry Angel filly from the good producing mare Watchmespin on debut for the Baker yard. Looked to have plenty up the sleeve after a recent 900m trial win at Rosehill. Leading player who can overcome the wide gate. LATEST FLAME (8) is a Savabeel filly from the stakes-winner Melt on debut for the Widdup stable. Wasn't knocked about in the two trials and will be strong late. The chances don't end there.
